en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Hasan bin Ibrahim bin Ahmad bin Mu’addab, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Ahmad bin Yahya, from Bikr bin Abdullah, from Nasr bin Ubaidullah, from Nasr bin Muzahim, that he said: I was told by Abdul-Ghafffar bin Qasem, from al-A’mash, from ‘Uday bin Thabit, from Baraa’ bin ‘Azib, that he said:

Abu Sufyan approached, while Mu’awiya was following him, and the Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: «O Allah, curse the following and the followed. O Allah, it is upon You to ruin the belittled lordotic.» Ibn Baraa’ said to his father: Who is the belittled lordotic? He said: Mu’awiya.
